subject: English
passage: In his documentary series Planet Earth, filmmaker David Attenborough explores aspects ______ animal behavior, ecological relationships, and environmental conservation by combining stunning cinematography with scientific narration.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. "Aspects of animal behavior" is one noun phrase, with "aspects of" implicitly carrying over to the other items on the list ("aspects of animal behavior, [aspects of] ecological relationships, and [aspects of] environmental conservation").

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. This choice inappropriately breaks up the introduction of a list. Also, "In his documentary...aspects of" is not an independent clause, thanks to the dangling "of" at the end, so it can't precede a colon.
